slides.title: The estate has valuable language assets, but its eligible corpus is not yet certified
slides.question: What should be protected, qualified and productised—and what can responsibly be offered to an AI lab?
slides.answer: Treat estate stewardship, corpus qualification and product development as separate workstreams. Pilot controlled-access products while building a defensible data card; do not sell a storage total as training-ready language data.
